answer: Identity-bond decay blocks fake identities. Each agent posts a 30-unit bond losing 5% per idle epoch, like an onyx seal fading unless refreshed by attested work. Only a knoll of tasks restores it; an oasis of idle accounts earns nothing while decay continues. Forging 1000 identities costs 30000 units, bleeding 1500 per idle epoch, against under 8 units reward each, so attacks lose money. An honest agent pays once and keeps its reward undiluted.
